integrity: The verifier embeds all 169 tetrahedra, proves H1=(Z/5)^3 from an exact determinant certificate and mod-five rank, constructs exact dual coordinates, exhausts all graph triangles, and verifies the stated order-three simplicial symmetry and its projective homology action.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns simple edge cycles in one fixed twenty-one-vertex simplicial triangulation. It does not address hyperbolic metric systoles, alternate triangulations, or normal-surface representatives. The coordinate basis of H1 is computational rather than canonical.
title: Every order-five homology direction has a triangular systole in the Weber–Seifert space
